tolerance_note: 30 ms not achievable with a single lag compensate across 30/120/240 s; floor is ~40 ms (MMS frame grain + onset variance).
root_cause_note: Round-4 p90 multi-second errors came from crushing each line segment to len(words)*280 ms — not from MMS frame hop. This test locks absolute timebase at late song positions through generate_word_timings.
